arxiv-2012-09892.title: Post quench entropy growth in a chiral clock model
arxiv-2012-09892.creator: Naveen Nishad, M Santhosh, G J Sreejith
arxiv-2012-09892.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Naveen Nishad, M Santhosh, G J Sreejith. We numerically study quenches from a fully ordered state to the ferromagnetic regime of the chiral ℤ 3 \mathbb{Z}_{3} clock model, where the physics can be understood in terms of sparse domain walls of six flavors.

arxiv-2111-14489.title: Using Topology to Estimate Structural Similarities of Proteins
arxiv-2111-14489.creator: Jørgen Ellegaard Andersen, Jens Ledet Jensen, Yuki Koyanagi, Jakob Toudahl Nielsen, Rasmus Villemoes
arxiv-2111-14489.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jørgen Ellegaard Andersen, Jens Ledet Jensen, Yuki Koyanagi, Jakob Toudahl Nielsen, Rasmus Villemoes. An effective model for protein structures is important for the study of protein geometry, which, to a large extent, determine the functions of proteins. There are a number of approaches for modelling; one might focus on the conformation of the backbone or H-bonds, and the model may be based on the geometry or the topology of the structure in focus.

arxiv-2301-01594.description: Abstract The increase in complexity of autonomous systems is accompanied by a need of data-driven development and validation strategies. Advances in computer graphics and cloud clusters have opened the way to massive parallel high fidelity simulations to qualitatively address the large number of operational scenarios.

arxiv-2302-08499.title: Non-Fermi liquids from kinetic constraints in tilted optical lattices
arxiv-2302-08499.creator: Ethan Lake, T. Senthil
arxiv-2302-08499.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ethan Lake, T. Senthil. We study Fermi-Hubbard models with kinetically constrained dynamics that conserves both total particle number and total center of mass, a situation that arises when interacting fermions are placed in strongly tilted optical lattices. Through a combination of analytics and numerics, we show how the kinetic constraints stabilize an exotic non-Fermi liquid phase described by fermions coupled to a gapless bosonic field, which in several respects mimics a dynamical gauge field.

arxiv-2306-02013.title: Instabilities of longitudinal vortex rolls in katabatic Prandtl slope flows Volume: 000 DOI: S002211200100456X
arxiv-2306-02013.creator: Cheng-Nian Xiao, Inanc Senocak
arxiv-2306-02013.description: Abstract Stationary counter-rotating longitudinal vortex pairs emerge from one-dimensional Prandtl slope flows under katabatic as well as anabatic conditions due to a linear instability when the imposed surface heat flux magnitude is sufficiently strong relative to the stable ambient stratification.

arxiv-2511-11086.title: Latent space models for grouped multiplex networks
arxiv-2511-11086.creator: Alexander Kagan, Peter W. MacDonald, Elizaveta Levina, Ji Zhu
arxiv-2511-11086.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexander Kagan, Peter W. MacDonald, Elizaveta Levina, Ji Zhu. Complex multilayer network datasets have become ubiquitous in various applications, such as neuroscience, social sciences, economics, and genetics. Notable examples include brain connectivity networks collected across multiple patients or trade networks between countries collected across multiple goods. Existing statistical approaches to such data typically focus on modeling the structure shared by all networks; some go further by accounting for individual, layer-specific variation.

pmc-11346337.creator: Chaofan Li, Yue Niu, Dinghua Chen, Zhe Feng, Fei Liu, Yong Wang, Xueying Cao, Jie Wu, Jiabao Liu, Xuefeng Sun, Li Zhang, Guangyan Cai, Ping Li, Xiangmei Chen
pmc-11346337.description: We aimed to test whether red blood cell distribution width (RDW) to monocyte percentage ratio (RMR) was associated with the acute-phase prognosis of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients. Prospective enrollment and 90-day follow-up of CKD patients with COVID-19 were conducted from December 1, 2022 to January 31, 2023.

pmc-11443458.title: Perceived Burden and Quality of Life in Caregivers of Patients with Schizophrenia in Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Province: A Cross-sectional Study
pmc-11443458.creator: Feras Al-Awad
pmc-11443458.description: Background and AimsFamily Caregivers (FCGs) of patients with schizophrenia (PwS) may face unanticipated sources of stress and responsibility, which can negatively impact their quality of life (QoL). This study aimed to assess FCGs' QoL and the impact of clinical characteristics of patients and sociodemographic factors on their QoL.

pmc-11653857.title: Inserting a VA-ECMO cannula through an inferior vena cava filter during extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation
pmc-11653857.creator: Genhua Mu, Rongliang Xu, Yiyun Wang, Chun Pan, Jianfeng Xie
pmc-11653857.description: Venoarterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VA-ECMO) has been utilized to treat massive pulmonary embolism (PE) accompanied by cardiac arrest or refractory cardiogenic shock. Our team opted for a femoral-femoral approach for vascular cannulation, using drainage and return cannulas in the common femoral vein and artery, respectively.

pmc-11975526.title: 多模态超声技术评估肥厚型心肌病患者及其一级亲属的心肌灌注与收缩功能
pmc-11975526.creator: Li YU, Shi ZENG, Qichang ZHOU, Zurong YANG, Yiyuan HUANG, 柳 宋
pmc-11975526.description: 目的肥厚型心肌病(hypertrophic cardiomyopathy，HCM)易导致心肌缺血和心功能不全，即使无明显心肌肥厚的基因突变携带者(基因阳性/表型阴性)也易进展成为HCM患者。本研究采用心肌声学造影(myocardial contrast echocardiography，MCE)与速度向量成像(velocity vector imaging，VVI)评价家族性HCM患者及其一级亲属的心肌血流灌注与收缩功能变化，旨在早期评估HCM患者的心肌血流灌注和心功能，以识别家族中基因阳性/表型阴性的危险人群。方法选取确诊为HCM且携带HCM肌小节突变基因的患者35例为G+/P+组；在家族中同期选取30例携带HCM肌小节突变基因但超声检查无室壁肥厚者为G+/P-组；另选性别、年龄相匹配的无基因突变的家族健康志愿者38例为正常对照组，分别行MCE和VVI检查，记录心肌再充盈峰值强度(peak intensity，PI)，达峰值强度时间(time to peak concentration，TP)，直线倾斜率(the ratio of declining intensity and declining time，dI/dT)及左室整体纵向应变(global longitudinal strain，GLS)、整体径向应变(global radial strain，GRS)和整体环向应变(global circumferential strain，GCS)，并比较其差异和分析相关性。结果与正常对照组和G+/P-组比较，G+/P+组PI、dI/dT、GLS及GRS均明显降低，TP明显增高(均P<0.05)，且GLS和GRS与PI均呈明显正相关(分别r=0.629，r=0.613；均 P<0.01)，GLS和GRS与TP均呈明显负相关(分别r=-0.597，r=-0.571；均P<0.01)，与对照组比较，G+/P-组GLS明显降低(P<0.05)，GRS、GCS、PI值、TP值及dI/dT值差异均无统计学意义(均P>0.05)。结论HCM患者心肌收缩功能受损，且与心肌灌注减少明显相关，无室壁肥厚的HCM肌小节基因突变携带者出现早期左室收缩功能异常，MCE和VVI可定量评估肥厚型心肌病患者及一级亲属的心肌灌注和收缩功能。Keywords: 肥厚型心肌病, 心肌声学造影, 速度向量成像, 肌小节基因突变, 应变 心肌缺血是肥厚型心肌病(hypertrophic cardiomyopathy，HCM)比较显著的病理生理学特征，其本质原因是冠脉微血管功能障碍[1-2]。此外，HCM患者心肌细胞钙离子代谢紊乱、代谢重构和线粒体功能障碍等会导致其心脏功能障碍[3-4]。因此，早期对HCM患者心肌灌注情况及心脏功能进行评估尤为重要。超声技术——速度向量成像(velocity vector imaging，VVI)和心肌声学造影(myocardial contrast echocardiography，MCE)分别可早期、准确地发现心肌力学和心肌灌注异常[5-6]，但同时应用2种技术评价HCM(尤其是无明显室壁肥厚的HCM肌小节基因突变携带者)的研究尚不多见。本研究通过应用MCE观察家族性HCM患者及其一级亲属局部心肌灌注的改变，同时应用VVI技术评价其局部心肌收缩功能，并探讨心肌灌注与收缩功能二者之间的关系。 对象与方法 对象与分组 选取2021年至2023年于中南大学湘雅二医院确诊的68例HCM患者的外周血进行基因检测，发现35例患者携带了HCM肌小节突变基因，即基因阳性表型阳性(G+/P+)，对其一级亲属进行基因检测和常规心脏超声检查，根据检查结果筛选出无室壁肥厚但携带HCM肌小节突变基因[即基因阳性表型阴性(G+/P-)]者30例。本回顾性研究已获得中南大学湘雅二医院医学伦理委员会批准(审批号：2021第162号)。所有研究对象均签署书面知情同意书。 G+/P+组纳入标准：1)超声心动图或磁共振检测左室舒张末期心脏任意部位室壁厚度≥15 mm；2)若有明确家族史者，检查发现存在无法解释的左室壁厚度≥13 mm[7]。排除标准：1)运动员心脏肥厚，主动脉瓣或肺动脉瓣狭窄、高血压、系统性或代谢性疾病、神经肌肉疾病、线粒体疾病等所致的室壁肥厚，心肌淀粉样变、Danon等浸润型心肌病；2)终末期HCM患者[左室射血分数(left ventricular ejection fraction，LVEF)<50%]；3)接受HCM外科手术治疗或伴有心房颤动。 G+/P-组纳入标准：1)经验证携带HCM肌小节突变基因；2)左室最大室壁厚度<13 mm。排除标准：1)合并有糖尿病、高血压、冠心病；2)合并有心肌致密化不全或淀粉样病变；3)合并有代谢性疾病及其他系统性疾病；4)合并显著肺部病变；5)超声心动图检查有先天性心脏病、中重度瓣膜狭窄及反流。 正常对照组为无基因突变的健康志愿者(n=38)，经临床检查排除心血管等疾病。 仪器和图像采集 常规超声心动图检查及VVI动态图像采集 使用配有VVI分析软件的Siemens SC2000超声诊断仪及频率为2.75~4.

pmc-12411869.title: Body mass index as a potential confounder in dutasteride and fertility studies
pmc-12411869.creator: Amir Reza Akbari, Benyamin Alam, Ahmed Ageed
pmc-12411869.description: fertility considerations in young men undergoing treatment for androgenic alopecia [1]. Although the study accounts for several important clinical variables, it appears to have overlooked a potentially significant confounding factor: body mass index (BMI). Obesity and higher BMI are independently linked with impaired semen parameters, including reduced sperm motility, concentration, and volume, as well as altered hormonal profiles [2].

pmc-12438976.title: Rethinking the psychosis spectrum: A meta-analysis unveils a nonlinear discontinuity in verbal learning deficits between at-risk conditions and psychotic disorders
pmc-12438976.creator: Florence Pilon, Charles-Édouard Giguère, Stéphane Potvin
pmc-12438976.description: BackgroundTransition from a categorical to a dimensional approach has been proposed in the field of psychosis. However, whether key features of schizophrenia, such as cognitive deficits, really do lie along a linear continuum remains uncertain. To explore this, we compared for the first time verbal learning impairments in six entities of the psychosis spectrum using linear, nonlinear, and categorical models.

pmc-12531868.title: Machine Learning-Guided Design of Rhenium Tricarbonyl Complexes for Next-Generation Antibiotics
pmc-12531868.creator: Miroslava Nedyalkova, Gozde Demirci, Youri Cortat, Kevin Schindler, Fatlinda Rahmani, Justine Horner, Mahdi Vasighi, Aurelien Crochet, Aleksandar Pavic, Olimpia Mamula, Fabio Zobi, Marco Lattuada
pmc-12531868.description: The escalating prevalence of antibiotic-resistant bacteria and the increasing complexity of managing severe infections emphasize the critical need for novel and effective antibiotics. Herein, we present a novel computational strategy focused on metal-based antibiotics, specifically rhenium (Re) complexes, for the rational design of next-generation antibacterial agents.

pmc-12602625.title: Engaging traders in strengthening seed systems in Tanzania: key drivers for selling grains of improved varieties of sorghum, common beans and groundnuts
pmc-12602625.creator: Dennis Ong’or, Justus Ochieng, Atupokile Mwakatwila, Mercy Mutua, Radegunda Kessy, Sylvia Kelemera, Paul Aseete, Emmanuel Mwenda, Joachim Madeni, Edith Kadege, Jean Claude Rubyogo
pmc-12602625.description: Seed systems in sub-Saharan Africa face constant challenges such as limited access to quality seeds and low varietal turnover. Despite numerous efforts aimed at formalizing seed markets, informal seed systems still dominate with 97% of smallholder farmers sourcing seeds of sorghum, common beans and groundnuts through farm-saved seed and local grain markets.

pmc-12732401.title: Somatic Psychoeducational Intervention Is Associated with Increased Oxytocin Levels, Improved Autonomic Function, and Reduced Psychological Distress Symptoms in Medical and Social Care Professionals
pmc-12732401.creator: Lourdes P Dale, Audrey N Dana, Hannah Lamont, Parmida Nazarloo, C Sue Carter, Stephen W Porges, Steven P Cuffe, Donnalea Van Vleet Goelz, Dawson Church
pmc-12732401.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives. Medical and social care professionals (MSCPs) are disproportionately affected by chronic occupational stress, placing them at elevated risk for autonomic dysregulation, affective disorders, and burnout. This preliminary study includes data obtained from two samples. The data protocols were approved by University of Florida’s IRB (IRB202200233 approved 24 February 2023 and IRB202401217 approved on 2 October 2024) and registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05766852 and NCT06580119).

pmc-12808719.title: Immune profiling identifies the contribution of extracellular vesicles to immune modulation and progression in prostate cancer
pmc-12808719.creator: Giovanni Pecoraro, Ginevra Sarnacchiaro, Giovanni Smaldone, Andrea Soricelli, Jessie Santoro
pmc-12808719.description: Prostate cancer is the fourth leading cause of death in men worldwide. Currently, the gold standard for PCa diagnosis remains the Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA); therefore, there is a growing demand for novel diagnostic approaches for early prediction of aggressive types of prostate cancer. The complexity of tumors is further enhanced by the presence of extracellular vesicles (EVs).

pmc-13226950.title: Dengue transmission risk in California under climate and land-use change: a semi-mechanistic modelling study
pmc-13226950.creator: Lisa I. Couper, Terrell J. Sipin, Samantha Sambado, Zoe Rennie, Kyle M. Shanebeck, Kelsey P. Lyberger, Philip P.A. Collender, Van Ngo, Justin V. Remais, Andrew J. MacDonald
pmc-13226950.description: SummaryBackgroundDengue cases are increasing in non-endemic regions due to environmental change and increasing travel and trade. For these non-endemic regions, estimating dengue risk is challenging as transmission is driven by both local environmental conditions and the introduction of viremic travelers.

pmc-13254326.title: Probing universal phase diagram of dimensional crossover with an atomic quantum simulator
pmc-13254326.creator: Jinyuan Tian, Zhongcheng Yu, Jing Liu, Chi-Kin Lai, Lorenzo Pizzino, Chengyang Wu, Hongmian Shui, Thierry Giamarchi, Hepeng Yao, Xiaoji Zhou
pmc-13254326.description: Dimensionality is a fundamental concept in physics, which plays a hidden but crucial role in various domains, including condensed matter physics, relativity and string theory, statistical physics, etc. In quantum physics, reducing dimensionality usually enhances fluctuations and leads to novel properties.

pmc-13316749.title: Regional Biomechanical and Topographic Changes after Transepithelial vs. Epithelium-off Continuous Accelerated Corneal Cross-linking in Keratoconus: Updated Stress-Strain Index as a Superior Biomarker
pmc-13316749.creator: BangXun Mao, ChangChang He, Qian Ye, WeiJia Liu, YiQian Li, Daniela Oehring, YuKe Zhang, XiaoMeng Li, ChenHao Zhao, HongJie Hu, JiaWei Gong, HanHui Hou, YuFeng Ye, ShiHao Chen, YiYu Li, Ahmed Elsheikh, FangJun Bao
pmc-13316749.description: PurposeTo compare regional biomechanical and topographic outcomes between transepithelial (Epi-on) and epithelium-off (Epi-off) continuous accelerated corneal cross-linking (ACXL) in keratoconus.DesignA retrospective cohort study.SubjectsSeventy-seven keratoconic eyes were included: 45 with Epi-on ACXL and 32 with Epi-off ACXL.MethodsAll eyes underwent ACXL (10 mW/cm2, 7.2 J/cm2).

pmc-13334547.title: Eudragit S100-coated microbeads of thiolated chitosan/casein for pH-responsive colon-targeted delivery of 6-mercaptopurine
pmc-13334547.creator: Huma Hameed, Syed Muhammad Ahmad, Shazia Akram Ghumman, Ali Irfan, Hafiz Shoaib Sarwar, Yousef A. Bin Jardan
pmc-13334547.description: 6-Mercaptopurine (6-MP) is a potent chemotherapeutic and immunosuppressive agent; however, its oral administration is limited by poor bioavailability and dose-dependent hepatotoxicity. This study aimed to develop and optimize a colon-targeted, pH-responsive delivery system for 6-MP using Eudragit S100-coated thiolated chitosan/casein microbeads (Eu-S100@TCh/CS) to enhance site-specific release and minimize systemic exposure.

pmc-13579810.title: Immunohistochemical evaluation of apelin and VEGF expression in cortisol-producing adrenal adenomas
pmc-13579810.creator: Hatice Çalişkan Burgucu, Tuğba Günler, Ethem Ömeroğlu, Yaşar Ünlü, Oğuzhan Aksu
pmc-13579810.description: PurposeIn this study, we aimed to investigate the immunohistochemical expression of apelin in tissue samples obtained from patients with Cushing’s syndrome (CS) due to cortisol-producing adrenal adenoma (CPA) and to compare these findings with normal adrenal cortex tissue. Additionally, we sought to evaluate the association of apelin expression with clinical, hormonal, and histopathological parameters.

pmc-13680491.title: Translation of frozen sections into FFPE images for skin cancer resection margins using generative AI
pmc-13680491.creator: Sang-Hoon Lee, Yu-Sung Chu, Yosep Chong, Seong Min Hong, Eung Ho Choi, Seung-Phil Hong, Taeyeong Kim, Sejung Yang, Minseob Eom
pmc-13680491.description: Frozen section (Frozen) analysis is essential for intraoperative margin assessment in skin cancer surgery, but assessment is limited by freezing artifacts that obscure cellular detail. Formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) histopathology, the gold standard, provides higher quality but requires >24 h for processing.
